test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Most natural diamonds have some type of______.
solution:
The correct answer is- 'flaw'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in the blank is* 'flaw'*.
 
• We use the word 'flaw' to refer - a mark or crack, in anything that indicates it is imperfect.
 
 
• Example- Due to the *flaw *in the design of the engine, it exploded abruptly.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct option is option 2).

 

The correct sentence: Most natural diamonds have some type of *flaw.*__
